028/**
029 * Routes messages to a publisher by providing a {@link Route} from a logger name and
030 * level.
031 */
032public sealed interface LogRouter extends LogLifecycle {
033
034        /**
035         * Finds a route.
036         * @param loggerName topic.
037         * @param level level.
038         * @return route never <code>null</code>.
039         */
040        public Route route(String loggerName, java.lang.System.Logger.Level level);
041
042        /**
043         * Global router which is always available.
044         * @return global root router.
045         */
046        public static RootRouter global() {
047                return GlobalLogRouter.INSTANCE;
048        }
049
050        /**
051         * A route is similar to a SLF4J Logger or System Logger but has a much simpler
052         * contract.
053         *
054         * The proper usage of Route in most cases is to call {@link #isEnabled()} before
055         * calling {@link #log(LogEvent)}.
056         *
057         * That is {@link #log(LogEvent)} does not do any checking if the event is allowed
058         * furthermore by first checking if {@link #isEnabled()} is true one can decide
059         * whether or not to create a {@link LogEvent}.
060         */
061        public sealed interface Route extends LogEventLogger {
062
063                /**
064                 * Determines if {@link #log(LogEvent)} maybe called.
065                 * @return true if log can be called.
066                 */
067                public boolean isEnabled();
068
069                /**
070                 * Route singletons and utilities.
071                 */
072                @CaseChanging
073                public enum Routes implements Route {
074
075                        /**
076                         * A route that is a NOOP and is always disabled.
077                         */
078                        NotFound {
079                                @Override
080                                public void log(LogEvent event) {
081                                }
082
083                                @Override
084                                public boolean isEnabled() {
085                                        return false;
086                                }
087
088                        };
089
090                }
091
092        }
093
094        /**
095         * Router flags for adhoc router customization.
096         */
097        @CaseChanging
098        public enum RouteFlag {
099
100                /**
101                 * The route will not use the global level resolver and will only use the level
102                 * config directly on the router.
103                 */
104                IGNORE_GLOBAL_LEVEL_RESOLVER;
105
106                static Set<RouteFlag> parse(Collection<String> value) {
107                        if (value.isEmpty()) {
108                                return EnumSet.noneOf(RouteFlag.class);
109                        }
110                        var s = EnumSet.noneOf(RouteFlag.class);
111                        for (var v : value) {
112                                s.add(parse(v));
113                        }
114                        return s;
115                }
116
117                static RouteFlag parse(String value) {
118                        return LogProperty.enumValue(RouteFlag.class, value);
119                }
120
121        }
122
123        /**
124         * Root router is a router that has child routers.
125         */
126        sealed interface RootRouter extends LogRouter permits InternalRootRouter {
127
128                /**
129                 * The sink to dispatch events to for a logger name, with <strong>no level based
130                 * gating</strong> - unlike {@link #route(String, java.lang.System.Logger.Level)},
131                 * the returned {@link LogEventLogger} always accepts
132                 * {@link LogEventLogger#log(LogEvent)} regardless of what level is currently
133                 * enabled. Use this when level gating is already handled independently (e.g. a
134                 * logger facade caching its own resolved level and re-checking it on every call)
135                 * and a level would otherwise have to be made up just to obtain a working sink.
136                 * @param loggerName topic.
137                 * @return event logger, never <code>null</code>.
138                 */
139                public LogEventLogger eventLogger(String loggerName);
140
141                /**
142                 * Level resolver to find levels for a log name.
143                 * @return level resolver.
144                 */
145                public LevelResolver levelResolver();
146
147                /**
148                 * Register for a router changes usually involving the level resolver being
149                 * updated by config.
150                 * @param router consumer that will be called with the updated router.
151                 * @apiNote its best to use the router in the consumer accept argument and not
152                 * this router even if they are usually the same.
153                 */
154                public void onChange(Consumer<? super RootRouter> router);
155
156                /**
157                 * If a logger name configuration is changeable.
158                 * @param loggerName logger name.
159                 * @return true if config changes are allowed.
160                 */
161                public boolean isChangeable(String loggerName);
162
163        }
164
165        /**
166         * Router routes messages to a publisher.
167         */
168        sealed interface Router extends LogRouter, LogEventLogger {
169
170                /**
171                 * The router name given if no router is explicitly declared.
172                 */
173                public static final String DEFAULT_ROUTER_NAME = LogProperties.DEFAULT_NAME;
174
175                /**
176                 * Level resolver.
177                 * @return level resolver.
178                 */
179                LevelResolver levelResolver();
180
181                /**
182                 * Log publisher.
183                 * @return publisher.
184                 */
185                LogPublisher publisher();
186
187                /**
188                 * Whether or not the publisher is synchronous. A synchronous publisher generally
189                 * blocks.
190                 * @return true if the publisher is synchronous.
191                 */
192                default boolean synchronous() {
193                        return publisher().synchronous();
194                }
195
196                @Override
197                default void log(LogEvent event) {
198                        /*
199                         * Only async publishers need a frozen (immutable, defensively copied) event.
200                         * A synchronous publisher fully encodes and writes the event on the calling
201                         * thread before this call returns, so there is no other thread that could
202                         * observe or race with further mutation (e.g. MDC.put/remove) of the live
203                         * event data - freezing there would just be wasted allocation on the hot
204                         * path. Freeze is a noop if the event is already frozen.
205                         */
206                        if (!synchronous()) {
207                                event = event.freeze();
208                        }
209                        publisher().log(event);
210                }
211
212                /**
213                 * Creates a builder from config.
214                 * @param name name of the route which the publisher will inherit.
215                 * @param config config.
216                 * @return builder.
217                 */
218                static Builder builder(String name, LogConfig config) {
219                        /*
220                         * Eagerly triggers LogProperties' own key-parameter-value validation now:
221                         * needed because a fully-explicit route (explicit appenders, level,
222                         * publisher) never triggers a single keyed property lookup on its own, so
223                         * without this a malformed name would otherwise never be validated. Wrapped
224                         * into a ValidationException the same way a generated builder's constructor
225                         * is, so a bad name reports the same exception type regardless of whether it
226                         * came from logging.routes (RainbowGum.Builder's own validateNames call) or a
227                         * direct programmatic builder(name, config) call like this one.
228                         */
229                        try {
230                                LogProperties.interpolateNamedKey(LogProperties.ROUTE_LEVEL_PREFIX, name);
231                        }
232                        catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
233                                throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(LogRouter.class, e);
234                        }
235                        return new Builder(name, config);
236                }
237
238                /**
239                 * Creates a router.
240                 *
241                 * @see AbstractRouter
242                 */
243                @FunctionalInterface
244                public interface RouterFactory {
245
246                        /**
247                         * Builder will call this factory if passed in.
248                         * @param publisher publisher from builder.
249                         * @param levelResolver level resolver from builder.
250                         * @param name name from builder.
251                         * @param config config from builder.
252                         * @return router.
253                         */
254                        public Router create(LogPublisher publisher, LevelResolver levelResolver, String name, LogConfig config);
255
256                        /**
257                         * Creates a router from a function.
258                         * @param function <strong>the function may return <code>null</code></strong>
259                         * which indicates to ignore.
260                         * @return factory.
261                         */
262                        static RouterFactory of(@SuppressWarnings("exports") Function<LogEvent, @Nullable LogEvent> function) {
263                                return (pub, lr, n, c) -> new AbstractRouter(n, pub, lr) {
264                                        @Override
265                                        protected @Nullable LogEvent transformOrNull(LogEvent event) {
266                                                return function.apply(event);
267                                        }
268                                };
269                        }
270
271                }
272
273                /**
274                 * Router builder.
275                 */
276                public final class Builder extends LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder<Builder> implements LogConfig.ConfigSupport {
277
278                        private final LogConfig config;
279
280                        private final String name;
281
282                        private final EnumSet<RouteFlag> flags = EnumSet.noneOf(RouteFlag.class);
283
284                        private RouterFactory factory = (publisher, levelResolver, n, c) -> new SimpleRouter(n, publisher,
285                                        levelResolver);
286
287                        private List<LogProvider<LogAppender>> appenders = new ArrayList<>();
288
289                        private Builder(String name, LogConfig config) {
290                                this.name = Objects.requireNonNull(name);
291                                this.config = config;
292                        }
293
294                        private @Nullable PublisherFactory publisher;
295
296                        @Override
297                        protected Builder self() {
298                                return this;
299                        }
300
301                        /**
302                         * Gets the currently bound config.
303                         * @return config.
304                         */
305                        @Override
306                        public LogConfig config() {
307                                return this.config;
308                        }
309
310                        /**
311                         * Adds a flag.
312                         * @param flag flag added if not already added.
313                         * @return this.
314                         */
315                        public Builder flag(RouteFlag flag) {
316                                flags.add(flag);
317                                return this;
318                        }
319
320                        /**
321                         * Adds an appender by giving an appender builder to a consumer.
322                         * @param name appender name.
323                         * @param consumer consumer.
324                         * @return this builder.
325                         */
326                        public Builder appender(String name, Consumer<LogAppender.Builder> consumer) {
327                                var builder = LogAppender.builder(name);
328                                consumer.accept(builder);
329                                this.appenders.add(builder.build());
330                                return this;
331                        }
332
333                        /**
334                         * Adds an appender.
335                         * @param appender appender provider.
336                         * @return this builder.
337                         */
338                        public Builder appender(LogProvider<LogAppender> appender) {
339                                this.appenders.add(Objects.requireNonNull(appender));
340                                return self();
341                        }
342
343                        /**
344                         * Sets the publisher. Only one publisher to router.
345                         * @param publisher publisher.
346                         * @return this builder.
347                         */
348                        public Builder publisher(PublisherFactory publisher) {
349                                this.publisher = publisher;
350                                return self();
351                        }
352
353                        /**
354                         * Factory to use for creating the router.
355                         * @param factory router factory.
356                         * @return this.
357                         */
358                        public Builder factory(RouterFactory factory) {
359                                this.factory = Objects.requireNonNull(factory);
360                                return this;
361                        }
362
363                        Router build() {
364                                return build(this.factory);
365                        }
366
367                        /**
368                         * Builds the router.
369                         * @param factory to create the router.
370                         * @return router.
371                         */
372                        Router build(RouterFactory factory) {
373                                String name = this.name;
374                                flags.addAll(rawValue(config.properties()
375                                        .forKey(LogProperties.ROUTE_FLAGS_PROPERTY, name)
376                                        .ofList()
377                                        .map(RouteFlag::parse)
378                                        .or(EnumSet.noneOf(RouteFlag.class))).value());
379                                String routerLevelPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateNamedKey(LogProperties.ROUTE_LEVEL_PREFIX, name);
380
381                                /*
382                                 * The route's own level config is resolved in isolation from the global
383                                 * level resolver so that a route level override takes priority per logger
384                                 * name instead of merging with global by prefix specificity (a more
385                                 * specific global override would otherwise win over a coarser route
386                                 * override even though the route is meant to take precedence). If the
387                                 * route has no opinion at all for a given name (resolves to Level.ALL)
388                                 * resolution falls through to the global resolver for that name, unless
389                                 * IGNORE_GLOBAL_LEVEL_RESOLVER is set in which case global is never
390                                 * consulted.
391                                 */
392                                var routeLevelResolverBuilder = LevelResolver.builder();
393                                var currentConfig = buildLevelConfigOrNull();
394                                if (currentConfig != null) {
395                                        routeLevelResolverBuilder.config(currentConfig);
396                                }
397                                routeLevelResolverBuilder.config(config.properties(), routerLevelPrefix);
398                                /*
399                                 * config.levelResolver() (the global resolver) has no caching of its own
400                                 * - the previous single merged CompositeLevelConfig relied on being
401                                 * wrapped in one outer cache for the whole route+global composition.
402                                 * LevelResolver.Builder.build() restores that guarantee (level resolvers
403                                 * are cached / static, see LevelResolver's class documentation) for the
404                                 * combined route+global resolver below.
405                                 */
406                                if (!flags.contains(RouteFlag.IGNORE_GLOBAL_LEVEL_RESOLVER)) {
407                                        routeLevelResolverBuilder.fallback(config.levelResolver());
408                                }
409                                var levelResolver = routeLevelResolverBuilder.build().provide(name, config);
410
411                                if (currentConfig == null) {
412                                        /*
413                                         * If no config is provided in this route the global level might not
414                                         * be set.
415                                         */
416                                        var level = levelResolver.resolveLevel("");
417                                        Objects.requireNonNull(level);
418                                        if (level == System.Logger.Level.ALL) {
419                                                /*
420                                                 * Neither the route nor the global level resolver have anything
421                                                 * configured. This is a bug if this happens as the builders and
422                                                 * other places will turn ALL -> TRACE.
423                                                 */
424                                                levelResolver = LevelResolver.builder()
425                                                        .resolver(levelResolver)
426                                                        .fallback(StaticLevelResolver.INFO)
427                                                        .build()
428                                                        .provide(name, config);
429                                        }
430                                }
431
432                                var _levelResolver = levelResolver;
433                                /*
434                                 * This routers level resolver needs to be notified if config changes.
435                                 */
436                                config.changePublisher().subscribe(c -> {
437                                        _levelResolver.clear();
438                                });
439                                var publisher = this.publisher;
440
441                                List<LogProvider<LogAppender>> appenders = new ArrayList<>(this.appenders);
442                                if (appenders.isEmpty()) {
443                                        DefaultAppenderRegistry.appenders(config, name) //
444                                                .stream() //
445                                                .forEach(appenders::add);
446                                }
447
448                                if (publisher == null) {
449                                        var properties = config.properties();
450                                        publisher = rawValue(properties.forKey(LogProperties.ROUTE_PUBLISHER_PROPERTY, name)
451                                                .ofProviderRef()
452                                                .map(r -> config.publisherRegistry().provide(r))
453                                                .or(() -> LogPublisher.SyncLogPublisher.builder().build())).value();
454                                }
455
456                                var apps = new LogAppender.Appenders(name, config, appenders);
457                                var pub = publisher.create(name, config, apps);
458                                /*
459                                 * Register the publisher and its appenders for lookup like status checks
460                                 * (see LogReporter). Registering "apps" itself rather than its resolved
461                                 * list lets a lookup happen after the fact regardless of whether the
462                                 * publisher called asList()/asSingle() eagerly here or lazily later, and
463                                 * Appenders.resolvedOrNull() returns null if the publisher never calls
464                                 * either (meaning it does not use the appenders this ordinary way at
465                                 * all).
466                                 */
467                                config.serviceRegistry().put(LogPublisher.class, name, pub);
468                                config.serviceRegistry().put(LogAppender.Appenders.class, name, apps);
469                                return factory.create(pub, levelResolver, name, config);
470                        }
471
472                        /*
473                         * Both flags and publisher above already have a fallback applied (Missing is
474                         * impossible), but a present-but-malformed value must still surface its raw,
475                         * unwrapped exception - not a "Validation failed for Builder:" wrapping,
476                         * which would also change the exception's public type away from
477                         * PropertyConvertException (see ConfigFailureTest's bogus-scheme publisher
478                         * case). LogProperty.Result no longer exposes value() itself (a bare Result
479                         * might still be Missing), so this just narrows to
480                         * LogProperty.ValidatedResult - true for every concrete Result - without
481                         * going through a Validator at all.
482                         */
483                        private static <T> LogProperty.ValidatedResult<T> rawValue(LogProperty.Result<T> result) {
484                                return switch (result) {
485                                        case LogProperty.ValidatedResult<T> vr -> vr;
486                                };
487                        }
488
489                }
490
491        }
492
493        /**
494         * A user supplied router usually for filtering or transforming purposes. The method
495         * required to implement is {@link #transformOrNull(LogEvent)}.
496         *
497         * @see RouterFactory
498         */
499        @SuppressWarnings("javadoc") // TODO Eclipse bug.
500        public non-sealed abstract class AbstractRouter implements Router, Route {
501
502                private final String name;
503
504                private final LogPublisher publisher;
505
506                private final LevelResolver levelResolver;
507
508                /**
509                 * Router tuple of publisher and resolver.
510                 * @param name router name not <code>null</code>.
511                 * @param publisher not <code>null</code>.
512                 * @param levelResolver not <code>null</code>.
513                 */
514                protected AbstractRouter(String name, LogPublisher publisher, LevelResolver levelResolver) {
515                        super();
516                        this.name = name;
517                        this.publisher = publisher;
518                        this.levelResolver = levelResolver;
519                }
520
521                @Override
522                public final boolean synchronous() {
523                        return Router.super.synchronous();
524                }
525
526                @Override
527                public final void log(LogEvent event) {
528                        var e = transformOrNull(event);
529                        if (e != null) {
530                                Router.super.log(e);
531                        }
532                }
533
534                /**
535                 * Implement for custom filtering or transformation.
536                 * @param event usually from logging facade.
537                 * @return event to be pushed to logger or not if <code>null</code>.
538                 */
539                protected abstract @Nullable LogEvent transformOrNull(LogEvent event);
540
541                @Override
542                public final Route route(String loggerName, Level level) {
543                        if (levelResolver().isEnabled(loggerName, level)) {
544                                return this;
545                        }
546                        return Route.Routes.NotFound;
547                }
548
549                @Override
550                public final void start(LogConfig config) {
551                        publisher.start(config);
552                }
553
554                @Override
555                public final void close() {
556                        publisher.close();
557
558                }
559
560                @Override
561                public final boolean isEnabled() {
562                        return true;
563                }
564
565                @Override
566                public final LevelResolver levelResolver() {
567                        return this.levelResolver;
568                }
569
570                @Override
571                public final LogPublisher publisher() {
572                        return this.publisher;
573                }
574
575                @Override
576                public String toString() {
577                        return getClass() + "[name=" + name + ", publisher=" + publisher + ", levelResolver=" + levelResolver + "]";
578                }
579
580        }
581
582}

585
586        @Override
587        public void close() {
588                publisher.close();
589        }
590
591        @Override
592        public Route route(String loggerName, java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
593                if (levelResolver().isEnabled(loggerName, level)) {

608
609}

611sealed interface InternalRootRouter extends RootRouter {
612
613        /**
614         * Sets the root router.
615         * @param router root router.
616         */
617        static void setRouter(RootRouter router) {
618                if (GlobalLogRouter.INSTANCE == router) {
619                        return;
620                }
621                GlobalLogRouter.INSTANCE.drain((InternalRootRouter) router);
622        }
623
624        static InternalRootRouter of(List<? extends Router> routes, LogConfig config) {
625
626                if (routes.isEmpty()) {
627                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("atleast one route is required");
628                }
629                List<Router> sorted = new ArrayList<>();
630                /*
631                 * We add the async routers first
632                 */
633                Set<Router> matched = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<Router, Boolean>());
634                for (var r : routes) {
635                        if (!r.synchronous()) {
636                                if (matched.add(r)) {
637                                        sorted.add(r);
638                                }
639                        }
640                }
641                for (var r : routes) {
642                        if (r.synchronous()) {
643                                if (matched.add(r)) {
644                                        sorted.add(r);
645                                }
646                        }
647                }
648                routes = sorted;
649                LevelResolver.Builder resolverBuilder = LevelResolver.builder();
650                routes.stream().map(Router::levelResolver).forEach(resolverBuilder::resolver);
651                var globalLevelResolver = resolverBuilder.build().provide("", config);
652
653                Router[] array = routes.toArray(new Router[] {});
654
655                RouteChangePublisher changePublisher = new RouteChangePublisher(
656                                s -> config.changePublisher().allowedChanges(s).contains(ChangeType.LEVEL));
657                if (array.length == 1) {
658                        var r = array[0];
659                        return new SingleRootRouter(r, changePublisher);
660                }
661                return new CompositeLogRouter(array, globalLevelResolver, changePublisher);
662        }
663
664        default boolean isEnabled(String loggerName, java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
665                return route(loggerName, level).isEnabled();
666
667        }
668
669        default void drain(InternalRootRouter delegate) {
670
671        }
672
673        @Override
674        default void onChange(Consumer<? super RootRouter> router) {
675                changePublisher().add(router);
676        }
677
678        public RouteChangePublisher changePublisher();
679
680        @Override
681        default boolean isChangeable(String loggerName) {
682                return changePublisher().loggerChangeable.apply(loggerName);
683        }
684
685        final class RouteChangePublisher {
686
687                private final Collection<Consumer<? super RootRouter>> consumers = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<Consumer<? super RootRouter>>();
688
689                private final Function<String, Boolean> loggerChangeable;
690
691                RouteChangePublisher(Function<String, Boolean> loggerChangeable) {
692                        super();
693                        this.loggerChangeable = loggerChangeable;
694                }
695
696                void add(Consumer<? super RootRouter> consumer) {
697                        consumers.add(consumer);
698                }
699
700                void publish(RootRouter router) {
701                        for (var c : consumers) {
702                                c.accept(router);
703                        }
704                }
705
706                void transferTo(RouteChangePublisher changePublisher) {
707                        changePublisher.consumers.addAll(consumers);
708                        this.consumers.clear();
709                }
710
711        }
712
713}
714

720        }
721
722        @Override
723        public void close() {
724                router.close();

727        @Override
728        public LevelResolver levelResolver() {
729                return router.levelResolver();

732        @Override

742}

744@SuppressWarnings("ArrayRecordComponent") // TODO revisit perf
745record CompositeLogRouter(Router[] routers, LevelResolver levelResolver,
746                RouteChangePublisher changePublisher) implements InternalRootRouter, Route {
747
748        @Override
749        public Route route(String loggerName, Level level) {
750                /*
751                 * The assumption is the provided level resolver is a cached composite level
752                 * resolver of all the routers.
753                 */
754                if (levelResolver.isEnabled(loggerName, level)) {
755                        return this;
756                }
757                return Routes.NotFound;
758        }
759
760        @Override
761        public LogEventLogger eventLogger(String loggerName) {
762                /*
763                 * log(LogEvent) below already fans out to every child router regardless of how it
764                 * was reached, so this composite is already its own sink - no per-child selection
765                 * happens until log() actually runs.
766                 */
767                return this;
768        }
769
770        @Override
771        public void log(LogEvent event) {
772                for (var router : routers) {
773                        var route = router.route(event.loggerName(), event.level());
774                        if (route.isEnabled()) {
775                                /*
776                                 * We assume async routers are earlier in the array.
777                                 */
778                                if (!router.synchronous()) {
779                                        /*
780                                         * Now all events are frozen from here onward to guarantee that the
781                                         * synchronous routers see the same thing as the async routers.
782                                         *
783                                         * Freeze is a noop if it already frozen.
784                                         */
785                                        event = event.freeze();
786                                }
787                                route.log(event);
788                        }
789                }
790        }
791
792        @Override
793        public boolean isEnabled() {
794                return true;
795        }
796
797        @Override
798        public void start(LogConfig config) {
799                for (var r : routers) {
800                        r.start(config);
801                }
802        }
803
804        @Override
805        public void close() {
806                for (var r : routers) {
807                        r.close();
808                }
809        }
810}

812final class QueueEventsRouter implements InternalRootRouter, Route {
813
814        private final ConcurrentLinkedQueue<LogEvent> events = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
815
816        private final LevelResolver levelResolver;
817
818        private final LevelResolver errorLevelResolver;
819
820        private final RouteChangePublisher changePublisher = new RouteChangePublisher(s -> true);
821
822        static QueueEventsRouter of() {
823                var validator = LogProperty.Validator.of(QueueEventsRouter.class);
824                var queueLevel = queueLevel().validate(validator);
825                var errorLevel = errorLevel().validate(validator);
826                validator.validate();
827                return new QueueEventsRouter(StaticLevelResolver.of(queueLevel.value()),
828                                StaticLevelResolver.of(errorLevel.value()));
829        }
830
831        private static LogProperty.Result<Level> queueLevel() {
832                var properties = LogProperties.StandardProperties.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES;
833                return properties.forKey(LogProperties.GLOBAL_QUEUE_LEVEL_PROPERTY)
834                        .ofString()
835                        .map(LevelResolver::parseLevel)
836                        .or(Level.INFO);
837        }
838
839        private static final LogProperty.Result<Level> errorLevel() {
840                var properties = LogProperties.StandardProperties.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES;
841                return properties.forKey(LogProperties.GLOBAL_QUEUE_ERROR_PROPERTY)
842                        .ofString()
843                        .map(LevelResolver::parseLevel)
844                        .or(Level.ERROR);
845        }
846
847        private QueueEventsRouter(LevelResolver levelResolver, LevelResolver errorLevelResolver) {
848                super();
849                this.levelResolver = levelResolver;
850                this.errorLevelResolver = errorLevelResolver;
851        }
852
853        @Override
854        public LevelResolver levelResolver() {
855                return levelResolver;
856        }
857
858        @Override
859        public Route route(String loggerName, Level level) {
860                if (levelResolver.isEnabled(loggerName, level)) {
861                        return this;
862                }
863                return Routes.NotFound;
864        }
865
866        @Override
867        public LogEventLogger eventLogger(String loggerName) {
868                return this;
869        }
870
871        @Override
872        public void start(LogConfig config) {
873        }
874
875        @Override
876        public void close() {
877                events.clear();
878        }
879
880        @Override
881        public void log(LogEvent event) {
882                events.add(event);
883                if (errorLevelResolver.isEnabled(event.loggerName(), event.level())) {
884                        MetaLog.error(event);
885                }
886        }
887
888        @Override
889        public void drain(InternalRootRouter delegate) {
890                LogEvent e;
891                while ((e = this.events.poll()) != null) {
892                        delegate.route(e.loggerName(), e.level()).log(e);
893                }
894        }
895
896        @Override
897        public boolean isEnabled() {
898                return true;
899        }
900
901        @Override
902        public RouteChangePublisher changePublisher() {
903                return this.changePublisher;
904        }
905
906}
907
908@SuppressWarnings("ImmutableEnumChecker")
909enum GlobalLogRouter implements InternalRootRouter, Route {
910
911        INSTANCE;
912
913        private volatile InternalRootRouter delegate = QueueEventsRouter.of();
914
915        private final ReentrantLock drainLock = new ReentrantLock();
916
917        @Override
918        public LevelResolver levelResolver() {
919                return delegate.levelResolver();
920        }
921
922        @Override
923        public boolean isEnabled() {
924                return true;
925        }
926
927        @Override
928        public void log(LogEvent event) {
929                InternalRootRouter d = delegate;
930                if (d instanceof QueueEventsRouter q) {
931                        q.log(event);
932                }
933                else {
934                        var route = d.route(event.loggerName(), event.level());
935                        if (route.isEnabled()) {
936                                route.log(event);
937                        }
938                }
939        }
940
941        @Override
942        public Route route(String loggerName, Level level) {
943                return this.delegate.route(loggerName, level);
944        }
945
946        @Override
947        public LogEventLogger eventLogger(String loggerName) {
948                return this.delegate.eventLogger(loggerName);
949        }
950
951        @Override
952        public boolean isEnabled(String loggerName, Level level) {
953                return this.delegate.isEnabled(loggerName, level);
954        }
955
956        @Override
957        public RouteChangePublisher changePublisher() {
958                return this.delegate.changePublisher();
959        }
960
961        @Override
962        public void drain(InternalRootRouter delegate) {
963                _drain(delegate);
964        }
965
966        private InternalRootRouter _drain(InternalRootRouter delegate) {
967                if (delegate == this) {
968                        throw new IllegalStateException("bug");
969                }
970                drainLock.lock();
971                try {
972                        var original = this.delegate;
973                        if (original instanceof QueueEventsRouter q) {
974                                q.changePublisher().transferTo(delegate.changePublisher());
975                                delegate.changePublisher().publish(delegate);
976                        }
977                        this.delegate = Objects.requireNonNull(delegate);
978                        original.drain(delegate);
979                        return original;
980                }
981                finally {
982                        drainLock.unlock();
983                }
984        }
985
986        @Override
987        public void start(LogConfig config) {
988        }
989
990        @Override
991        public void close() {
992                var d = _drain(QueueEventsRouter.of());
993                d.close();
994        }
995
996}
